tensuramoreskills.race.blood_monarch.des: A sovereign monster of cursed blood. Blood Monarchs bend stolen Blood into overwhelming power, turning blood reserves into brutal damage amplification, durable crimson guards, and superior recovery.
tensuramoreskills.race.blood_noble.descr: A highborn Bloodfiend capable of ruling lesser kindred. Blood Nobles possess a larger blood reserve, stronger regeneration, sharper Blood Arts, and a greater talent for binding weakened mobs into blood thralls.
tensuramoreskills.race.bloodfiend.descri: A cursed bloodline race that survives by stealing blood from living prey. Bloodfiends store Blood as a special resource, using it to regenerate, empower attacks, guard their body, brand victims, and create lesser kindred. Rain and water corrode their blood, while lower-generation Bloodfiends wield stronger Blood Arts.
tensuramoreskills.race.crimson_progenito: The origin point of a Bloodfiend lineage. A Crimson Progenitor carries the purest cursed blood, commanding immense blood capacity, terrifying Blood Arts, and the least vulnerability to water among its bloodline.
A matured Bloodfiend whose cursed blood has stabilized into a stronger spiritual body. Elder Bloodfiends hold more Blood, suffer less from water, and wield refined Blood Arts with greater control.
tensuramoreskills.race.example_race.note: This is a fully custom race that you can change and control to your liking!
tensuramoreskills.race.parasite.notes: A fragile 5-health parasite race with no intrinsic skills and no evolutions.
tensuramoreskills.skill.abhoth_lord_of_p: The evolved lord of fungal plague.
No active effects were found to mutate.
No living hosts were found for sequencing.
You do not have enough biomass to rip away.
tensuramoreskills.skill.acedia_bushyasta: The convergence of Stagnation and Sloth. Where time halts, will decays, and existence itself forgets how to move.
tensuramoreskills.skill.adaptability.des: A unique skill that evolves through punishment.
tensuramoreskills.skill.anti_symbiote.de: The frozen remnant of a severed symbiosis.
tensuramoreskills.skill.arthur_once_and_: Arthur, The Once and Future King
The perfected crown of a true king. Builds royal power in combat, rules holy and Battlewill damage, masters weapons, and commands Excalibur.
tensuramoreskills.skill.asmoday.descript:
Space abides no reason—
For the ████ disregards all boundaries.
And yields to no law but its own.
tensuramoreskills.skill.atomic_test_ulti: Compresses annihilation into a point for 6 seconds—then speaks: "I AM ATOMIC"... and fires a world-cleaving beam.
tensuramoreskills.skill.authority_of_gre:
A heart once claimed cannot escape desire.
The king hoards his own fate,
and greed denies even death its payment.
A pseudo heart has been claimed.
tensuramoreskills.skill.avalon_god_of_et: Avalon, God of the Eternal Kingdom
The eternal kingdom made absolute. Multiplies holy, light, Battlewill and physical power, imposes Royal Laws, opens Avalon, and commands the twelve knights of the Round Table.
tensuramoreskills.skill.axiom.inversion: FATE INVERSION: Judgment rejects your death.
A forbidden final Bloodfiend intrinsic reserved for the Crimson Progenitor.
tensuramoreskills.skill.blood_arts.descr: An intrinsic Bloodfiend art that manipulates stolen Blood. Drain blood from enemies, awaken Blood Surge to amplify damage, guard yourself with Crimson Guard, brand prey, or perform the Kindred Rite on weakened mobs.
tensuramoreskills.skill.boogie_woogie.de: Aoi Todo's technique. Swap positions with marked targets and manipulate the battlefield through instant exchange.
tensuramoreskills.skill.caedros_god_of_c: Cloud the Skies is already active in this world.
The red clouds disperse and Caedros releases the realm.
The skies cloud and a white desert swallows the world...
You summon the Ashen Halberd of Conquest.
The god of conquest, guilt and ruin. Wields an ashen halberd and twists the world into a blood-red realm.
tensuramoreskills.skill.chara.judgement_: J U D G E M E N T
tensuramoreskills.skill.chara_evolution_: A being defined by DETERMINATION and inevitable execution. Forces a target player into JUDGEMENT, locking both in place and suspending normal damage. Each successful strike during JUDGEMENT tears away 20% of the target's maximum health—surpassing five hits results in absolute death. Outside of JUDGEMENT, Chara overwhelms enemies through execution, fate manipulation, and the refusal to die.
tensuramoreskills.skill.cursed_menagerie: Records slain beings into your shadows. Browse the catalog, summon a parade, fuse curses into a single apex, or unleash a domain that floods the area with shadow clones.
tensuramoreskills.skill.divine_general_m: ✦ Mahoraga adapts: Your attacks now carry Cook.
A King-Class Ultimate that adapts to everything it survives.
Press a row to select it. Use Toggle to enable or disable the selected adaptation.
✦ Mahoraga adapts: Your attacks now carry Severance.
tensuramoreskills.skill.domain_of_negati: A negation sphere that seals hostile abilities.
tensuramoreskills.skill.elfaria_the_hall: Drop one item near an Ars Weiss clone. If it is an ore or block sample, the clone searches, mines, gathers drops, and returns them. Otherwise it gathers matching items.
The possessed body shattered. You returned to the main body.
The main body was destroyed. Parallel bodies collapse.
Myrdas Fridoliete denies death and freezes the field.
Myrdas Fridoliete cannot deny another death today.
Consciousness transferred to an Ars Weiss body.
Consciousness returned to the main body.

The card crumbles. That fate was already yours.

You return from limbo wearing another fate.

Time abides no reason—
For it deprives us all equally.
Yet brooks not a second to be reclaimed.
tensuramoreskills.skill.kronairos_lord_o: An endless sovereign that devours strength. Doubles EP gain, steals MP, weakens nearby foes, and enforces Infinite Imprisonment.

tensuramoreskills.skill.netherveil_overm: Opens the Gate and births a living infection. Place the Heart once, spread Sculk across the world, empower it by feeding ores, and appoint controllers to expand the Netherveil.

tensuramoreskills.skill.witch_of_vainglo: The deleted damage rewinds—reality pays back your suffering.
The timeline around you fractures and becomes soft.
Everyone’s senses twist. Nothing feels real anymore.
Your arms are coated in impossible reality.
The world snaps back into place.
Reality is rewritten. Your death is denied.
Reality refuses to be rewritten again today.
The world remembers the place they belong.
Reality corrects your existence. You were never here.
